claim: The $D000 map-control register: MAPC EQU $D000 — the write that selects the $C000 banked window.

corroboration.note: at mamedev/mame aaac1f637a8: bank_select_w mapped at $D000-$DFFF — the same write range, the banked-ROM model

claim: The *CB2 IRQ pin comment — the author naming under question in OQ-1; MAME wires the video count line VA11 to CB1, and the handler writes CRB, so the comment is the slip.

corroboration.note: at mamedev/mame aaac1f637a8: CB1 is the PIA input the driver wires the video-count line VA11 to (comment above the cb1_w call)

claim: RESET CLR MAPC SETUP PIAS — the PIA setup whose decode settles OQ-2: CRA ends at $14, CA1/COUNT240 interrupt disabled.

corroboration.note: at mamedev/mame aaac1f637a8: CA1 is the PIA input the driver drives high from scanline 240 (comment above the ca1_w call)

claim: WDOG EQU $C3FC — the address the source strokes; MAME decodes it as the mirrored video-control write, with the watchdog reset at $C3FF only.

corroboration.note: at mamedev/mame aaac1f637a8: video_control_w at $C010 with mirror $03E0 — folds $C3FC onto the register; watchdog_reset_w sits at $C3FF only (previous line, 499)

claim: WDATA EQU $38 with the ($39=FLIPPED) alternative — the screen-flip data pair the cocktail decoder-PROM variant exists to display.

corroboration.note: at mamedev/mame aaac1f637a8: original PCBs used one video-decoder PROM, cocktail-capable boards two (decoder2/decoder3) for the inversion (driver header note, 29-31)

claim: The IRQ handler re-arms the video interrupt on exit: STA PIA1+1 writes the $05 loaded the line above into the B-side control register — CRB, the OQ-1 register-level evidence.

corroboration.note: at mamedev/mame aaac1f637a8: the cb1_w call — the B-side line the CRB $04/$05 writes control

claim: The RESET setup programs CRA last: STA 1,X stores $14 (the $04 base ORed with $10) — CA1 interrupt disabled, CA2 armed for the SLAM switch; the OQ-2 decode.

corroboration.note: at mamedev/mame aaac1f637a8: the ca1_w call — the CA1 line that RESET leaves interrupt-disabled

claim: The IRQ handler masks the video interrupt on entry: STA PIA1+1 stores the $04 loaded the line above into CRB — the entry half of the $04/$05 pair whose exit half is BF-6.
